scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e ../../.env -- dbmate -e DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL -d migrations --migrations-table crm.schema_migrations --no-dump-schema up
scripts.db:rollback: dotenv -e ../../.env -- dbmate -e DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL -d migrations --migrations-table crm.schema_migrations --no-dump-schema rollback
scripts.db:codegen: dotenv -e ../../.env -- sh -c 'kysely-codegen --url "$DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL" --dialect postgres --default-schema crm --include-pattern "crm.*" --exclude-pattern crm.schema_migrations --out-file src/generated/db.d.ts --type-only-imports'
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e ../../.env -- dbmate -e DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL -d migrations --migrations-table crm.schema_migrations --no-dump-schema drop && dotenv -e ../../.env -- dbmate -e DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL -d migrations --migrations-table crm.schema_migrations --no-dump-schema up
